title: Data Register
body:
The register in an [[I-O Interface]] that the actual bytes pass through. The [[CPU]] reads
it to receive data from the device and writes it to send data out; the interface hardware
moves it the rest of the way. On the receive side of a [[UART]] this is the
[[RDR]].

One of the three registers every interface exposes, alongside the [[Status Register]] and
the [[Control Register]].
